newsitem.title: HUNGARY: LUFTHANSA TO BOOST FLIGHTS TO BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: LUFTHANSA TO BOOST FLIGHTS TO BUDAPEST.

text.p: Germany's national airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG plans to boost its weekly total of scheduled flights at Budapest Ferihegy Airport to 71 from 51 starting March 30, Hungary's Airport Coordination Service (ACS) said on Wednesday.
Lufthansa will add the flights to its current Budapest connections with Berlin, Dusseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich and Stuttgart, Helen Guraly, ACS's general airport coordinator, told Reuters.
The expanded schedule is valid until October 15, she said.
Aircraft serving the routes include Airbus A319s and A320s, Boeing B737-300s and B737-500s, Bombardier Aerospace Canadair Regional Jets, and British Aerospace Avro RJ80s, Guraly added.
